title: Handshake
bio: Handshake is a career platform that connects college students and recent graduates with employers offering internships and entry-level jobs.

title: Headspace
bio: American mental wellness app offering guided meditation, sleep content and access to coaching and therapy for individuals and employers.

title: HMD
bio: HMD makes smartphones and feature phones under its own brand and has produced Nokia-branded phones under license.

title: Hopper
bio: Mobile travel booking app that predicts flight and hotel prices and sells flights, hotels and rental cars.

title: Hostinger
bio: Web hosting company offering shared, cloud and VPS hosting plus a website builder.

title: Huda Beauty
bio: Dubai-based cosmetics brand selling eyeshadow palettes, false lashes, foundation, lip products and setting powder.

title: Huel
bio: British company selling nutritionally complete powdered meals, ready-to-drink shakes, hot meals and snack bars, mainly online.

title: Idealista
bio: Idealista is a property portal for buying and renting homes, offices and other property in Spain, Italy and Portugal.

title: Immobiliare.it
bio: Immobiliare.it is an Italian property portal listing homes and commercial properties for sale and rent.

title: Impossible Foods
bio: American company that makes plant-based meat substitutes, including Impossible burgers, sausages, nuggets and ground beef alternatives.

title: Independent Reserve
bio: Independent Reserve is a cryptocurrency exchange serving customers in Australia, New Zealand and Singapore for buying and selling digital assets.

title: inDrive
bio: Ride-hailing app where passengers propose a fare and drivers accept or counter, also offering intercity rides and deliveries.

title: Instructure
bio: American education technology company that makes the Canvas learning management system used by schools and universities to run courses online.

title: Internshala
bio: Internshala is an Indian platform where students and recent graduates find internships and fresher jobs and take online training courses.

title: italki
bio: Online marketplace that connects language learners with independent teachers for paid one-to-one video lessons in many languages.

title: iyzico
bio: iyzico provides online payment processing for merchants and a digital wallet for shoppers in Turkey.

title: JetBrains
bio: JetBrains makes software development tools, including IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm and other code editors, and created the Kotlin programming language.

title: Jimdo
bio: German website builder that helps small businesses create and host websites and online stores using templates.

title: Jobberman
bio: Jobberman is an online job platform in Nigeria and Ghana that connects job seekers with employers and offers recruitment services.

title: Kahoot!
bio: Norwegian learning platform that lets teachers, trainers and users create and play game-based quizzes in classrooms, workplaces and at home.

title: Keka
bio: Keka provides HR and payroll software covering attendance, leave, performance reviews and hiring for businesses in India and abroad.

title: Klook
bio: Booking platform for tours, attractions, activities and local transport.

title: KOHO
bio: KOHO is a Canadian financial app offering a prepaid card, spending account, savings, credit building and budgeting tools.

title: Konga
bio: Konga is a Nigerian online marketplace selling electronics, phones, fashion and household goods with delivery across Nigeria.

title: Kraken
bio: US cryptocurrency exchange for trading crypto assets.

title: KuCoin
bio: Cryptocurrency exchange listing a wide range of coins.

title: Lalamove
bio: Hong Kong-based on-demand delivery app that connects customers with drivers of motorcycles, vans and trucks for same-day deliveries.

title: Ledger
bio: Ledger makes hardware wallets and companion software that let users store cryptocurrency private keys offline and manage digital assets.

title: Lime
bio: Electric scooter and bike sharing service available in many cities.
